Yamato: "Hey, we're back, but what are we doing?"
Take a break
Listen to Yamato's explanation again
Leave the room
Touya: "I'm tired... I think I'll sleep
until we arrive..."
Yamato: "Huh? Are you really sure?"
Touya: "I've had enough. I'm going to sleep."
Yamato: "Oh, Touya... Honestly!"
Touya: "You get some rest too. If you don't sleep, you won't be
any use when it counts."
Yamato: "All right, all right. I understand.
I think I'll sleep too, then... There we go."
Touya: "...You sound like an old lady."
Yamato: "How rude. Calling a beautiful maiden like me
something like that! Honestly, this boy..."
Touya: "...Heh heh."
Yamato: "?"
Touya: "...Hey, Yamato..."
Yamato: "What is it?"
Touya: "What's going to happen to us now?"
Yamato: "...Do you want to go home?"
Touya: "Well, even if we go back, it'll just be the same days
over and over... I don't really mind either way, but..."
Yamato: "But?"
Touya: "...No, it's nothing.
Good night, then."
Yamato: "Good night."
Touya: (Kasumi, Koichiro... I wonder how they're doing...)
Yamato: "Again? I don't mind.
I'll explain as many times as it takes until you understand."
Listen properly
Never mind
Yamato: "...Ahem! First, what's important is meeting
someone. Nothing can start unless you do."
Touya: "Huh? That's obvious."
Yamato: "Then do you know how to find them?
Do you know who's where?"
Touya: "Of course not. I can only try rooms at random."
Yamato: "Hee hee... Well, I can tell you!
With my purrsonal sensor!
It tells me exactly where everyone is!"
Touya: "...What's this 'purrsonal sensor'?
I get that it's some kind of personal sensor, but..."
Yamato: "Hmph. As for that... I don't really know either."
Touya: "...Hey."
Yamato: "I-I'm joking! Honestly. Well, it seems to have a function
that picks up certain people's brainwaves.
So I can tell who's where in a flash.
It actually had a much more complicated name,
but it does the same thing, so I named it myself.
What do you think? Pretty cool, isn't it?"
Touya: "Well, it is a handy function.
Don't tell me Gabon added that too."
Yamato: "That's right."
Touya: "...Honestly, that old guy. Even something like that..."
Yamato: "It's useful, so what's wrong with it? Apparently,
it's really meant for emergencies. It seems to detect when
brainwaves differ from the registered patterns."
Touya: "When the patterns differ?"
Yamato: "Hmm, when someone's emotions are running high, when they're suffering,
or thinking strongly about something..."
Touya: "So, in special circumstances?"
Yamato: "Right. So if you go to someone I've detected,
something should happen.
Well, not necessarily every time."
Touya: "I see. Then let's get started..."
Yamato: "Stop! I haven't finished talking yet.
There's one more important thing.
You can just talk normally, but sometimes you want to discuss
topics you've picked up through your actions, right?"
Touya: "W-Well, yeah..."
Yamato: "When that happens, just press the Y button
and select 'Topic List.' Important information you've obtained
will be displayed. From there,
choose the word you want to discuss, then just speak
to the person you want to talk to. That's all!"
Touya: "Huh... But that person won't necessarily
know about it, right?"
Yamato: "Tsk, tsk, tsk. You'll see that each topic
clearly tells you who it's meant for, so
don't worry. Someone's name appears in '( )' after the word,
and the topic you selected is shown too,
so that's all taken care of."
Touya: "Then I can relax..."
Yamato: "Oh, right. About those topics...
You can't choose them forever."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Yamato: "There's a value called Topic Points.
When you select a topic and talk to that person, you lose one point.
And once it reaches zero,
you can't choose any more.
So you need to think about what you choose,
instead of just trying everything."
Touya: "Sounds like a pain."
Yamato: "Don't say that.
The world's not so kind that you can get by
just making it up as you go."
Touya: "Yeah, yeah."
Yamato: "Hmm, what else do I need
to explain...? 'Move,' I suppose."
Touya: "What's that?"
Yamato: "It's a system for going straight to a place when
walking around the map every time is too much trouble. Select it,
and you'll see the names of different places in Liebhofen.
Choose one there,
and you can instantly move to that location. Handy, isn't it?
But until you get used to it, it's better to walk there yourself.
Use it too much, and you might lose track
of where you are.
Each floor of Liebhofen has a simple layout,
but there are five of them, so don't get careless."
Touya: "Yeah. You're right."
Yamato: "Good, you're listening. One last thing:
once you've done enough, select 'Finish.'
That will end this phase."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "That's a brief explanation, but that's everything.
Now it's best to try it and get a feel for it yourself."
Okay, I get it. Let's go, then.
Could you explain it again?
Yamato: "Really? Then what will you do now?"
Rest until we reach the Holy Land
Leave the room
Touya: "Clovis, you're in there, right? Can I come in?"
Clovis: "Oh, Touya. Wait a second, I'll open up!"
Touya: "Yeah."
Clovis: "..."
Touya: "Hmm? You look a little pale..."
Yamato: "...?"
Clovis: "Eeeek! A m-monster cat!"
Touya: "Wh-What? Why are you shutting the door?!
Monster cat...? Oh!"
Yamato: "...Oh, right. He doesn't like me.
That's the second time he's called me that. How awful!"
Clovis: "Touya, I'm sorry, but I'm no good with cats.
I can't have you both in my room. Sorry!"
Yamato: 'I'll wait here.'
Touya: 'You don't have to worry about it.'
Yamato: 'But...'
Touya: 'It's fine. It's not like I had anything important to ask.'
Yamato: 'Really?'
Touya: "Clovis! We just remembered something we need to do,
so we're leaving."
Clovis: "I'm really sorry! Come again...
when your partner's not with you."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Why does he hate cats so much?"
Touya: "Who knows? He'll tell us himself
if he ever wants to."
Arthur: "Yes?"
Touya: "It's Touya..."
Arthur: "Ah, please come in."
Yamato: "Wow..."
Arthur: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "No, I was just thinking how different everyone's rooms are..."
Arthur: "Are they? Aren't they all the same?"
Yamato: "They're the same size, but... What's inside..."
Touya: "They're really distinctive..."
Arthur: "I see. May I take that
as a straightforward compliment?"
Touya: "Yeah. The layout really suits you, Arthur.
I think it looks good."
Yamato: "There's a faint whiff of sorcery, though..."
Arthur: "I-Is there...?"
Yamato: "Wow! What's this?
There's so much I've never seen before!"
Touya: "Hey, don't just touch things without asking."
Yamato: "I know."
Arthur: "Heh heh... I'll be counting on you from now on too."
Touya: "Counting on me, huh..."
Arthur: "What are you saying?
You're the first pilot to learn to control a Spirit Mech this quickly
and achieve results in actual combat.
Even we needed a fair amount of training to get this far,
so have confidence in yourself."
Touya: "Confidence..."
Arthur: "In any case, we don't know when the enemy will act.
They could attack at any moment.
Let's keep fighting together."
Touya: "Sorry, but I still can't give you a proper answer.
There's something that keeps bothering me..."
Arthur: "I see..."
Yamato: "Touya, Touya!
Look at this! I've never seen anything like it."
Touya: "Hey! I told you not to..."
Arthur: "Ha ha, I don't mind.
And if anything's troubling you,
please talk to me at any time.
We're among the few people here from the same world, after all."
Touya: "Yeah. We probably wouldn't have met
if it weren't for all this. Sorry to bother you."
Arthur: "Huh? Didn't you need something from me?"
Touya: "It's done. I just came to say hello."
Arthur: "I see. That's a good thing.
Well, do your best."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "There's so much in the world we don't know about.
I'm amazed."
Touya: "Of course. Even back in Japan, where we live,
there's still plenty we don't know about.
What's right in front of you isn't everything."
Yamato: "That's true."
Fain: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "It's about the Mireon you piloted..."
Fain: "Oh! Is it fixed already?"
Touya: "Huh? Oh, no... The truth is..."
Yamato: 'Hey, maybe you shouldn't tell him that.
They said they still don't know
how it'll turn out...'
I'm sorry, but Mireon's beyond repair.
It isn't fixed yet, but everyone's working hard.
Fain: "Ha ha ha! You're quite the joker.
My Mireon couldn't possibly break from something like that!"
Touya: "Well, they did say they'd do their best to repair it, but..."
Fain: "Well, there's no need to worry.
I'll show you what I can do next time!
Bwa ha ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Well... Shall we go?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Fain: "Oh! Everyone's working hard for me!
Ha ha ha! It's hard being someone everyone's counting on,
bwa ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "..."
Fain: "Touya, thanks for letting me know.
I'll have to work hard to live up to everyone's expectations!"
Touya: "I-I see. Well, good luck.
We'll be going, then..."
Fain: "Yeah. All right, back to training!"
